description: List the requests in a community or council district, newest first, with any status, paged with limit and offset. Each has its status, days to close or days open, address and the agency's resolution text; by_status counts each status and says in plain words what it means. Filter by problems, descriptions, agency, status, or statuses (the City's own values). For one address use address_history; for only what is still open, still_open. From BoardStat (BetaNYC, NYC Open Data, 2020 on); not an official City report. 311 counts are reports, not problems; 'closed' is not 'fixed'.

agency.description: Agency code as 311 writes it, e.g. 'NYPD'.

community_district.description: 306, BK06 or 'Brooklyn 6' (all forms: server instructions). Not with council_district.

council_district.description: Council district, 1 to 51. Not with community_district.

data_as_of.description: For the next page, next_page.data_as_of; a page from a newer build is refused.

descriptions.description: 311 descriptors, e.g. ['Blocked Bike Lane']; a missing one is '(none)'.

exclude_descriptions.description: Leave out these descriptions instead of keeping only them.

last_days.description: The last N days of data, ending on the newest request's day (not today).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0); for the next page, next_page.offset.

problems.description: BoardStat problem names, e.g. ['HEAT/HOT WATER']; any case.

statuses.description: The City's status values to keep (seen: Closed, Open, In Progress, Pending, Assigned, Started, Unspecified); any case.

name: find_requests
